name: The Flame's Casing

narrative.details:
We need one final piece to form the torch.

In the mountains to the northwest you will find a large encampment of Twilight's Hammer. It is rumored that they carry symbols and idols that pay homage to their god. These symbols and idols could carry sufficient enchantment to form a magical casing. Bring me a single symbol of Ragnaros and I will try to extract the magic from the item to create the casing.
narrative.objectives: Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.
narrative.offerRewardText: The symbol radiates foul magic; perfectly suited for our task.
narrative.requestItemsText: Without a suitable source of arcane energy, the torch of retribution cannot be completed.

chain.subtitle: 11 quests from level 48 to 58, 39,300 XP in all.

quests.name: Divine Retribution
quests.objectiveText: Listen as Kalaran Windblade tells his story.

quests.name: The Flawless Flame
quests.objectiveText: Collect 4 Hearts of Flame and 4 globes of Golem Oil and return the items to Kalaran Windblade.

quests.name: Forging the Shaft
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Thorium Plated Daggers to Kalaran Windblade.

quests.name: The Flame's Casing
quests.objectiveText: Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.

quests.name: The Torch of Retribution
quests.objectiveText: Wait for Kalaran Windblade to complete the Torch of Retribution.

quests.name: Set Them Ablaze!
quests.objectiveText: Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings.

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
quests.objectiveText: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar. You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths.
